evidence.decision: Distinguishes primary/auxiliary/context-following spaces, deciding when reuse or new windows preserve identity and parallel work without clutter.
evidence.artifact: Requires window identity/adaptation changes or an open/reuse/size/ownership specification and container lifecycle.
evidence.transformation: Spatial model example keeps property tools in existing context and moves deep clipped content into a deliberately scaled volume with bounded attachments.
evidence.verification: Tests repeated opens, documents, size extremes, close/reopen and activation state; fails wrong-object reuse, unreachable controls or selected-container clipping.
evidence.applicability: Preserves iPad window-control clearance, Mac key/main/inactive cues, visionOS window-versus-volume distinctions and the component source unsupported platforms.
evidence.handoffs: Routes contextual floating tools to panels, in-window supplements to split-views and app/window continuity to multitasking.
evidence.distinctiveness: Window identity, size constraints, native ownership and shallow-window-versus-deep-volume choices create specific container decisions without claiming spatial-device validation.
